<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-twoslsbootstraptheorem12-8-distribution-of-observed-textbook-fourth">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.TwoSLSBootstrapTheorem12_8.distribution_of_observed_textbook_fourth</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen-facing Theorem 12.8 distribution result from observed textbook
Assumption 12.2 and a nonzero one-row restriction.</p>
<p>Both the bootstrap coefficient limit and the studentized robust one-row limit
are conclusions; coefficient linearization and robust covariance resampling
are derived internally from the observed fourth-moment assumptions. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {k : Type u_2} {l : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype k] [inst_1 : Fintype l] [inst_2 : DecidableEq k]

<details class="lean-declaration" id="decl-hanseneconometrics-theorem12-16-observed">
<summary><span class="declaration-kind">theorem</span> <code>HansenEconometrics.Theorem12_16.observed</code></summary>
<div class="declaration-body">
<div class="declaration-doc"><p>Hansen Theorem 12.16 from the literal observed-row finite-fourth-moment
Assumption 12.2 package and conditional homoskedasticity, with the scalar
variance positivity derived from <code>Ω &gt; 0</code> rather than assumed separately. </p></div>
<details class="formal-statement"><summary>Formal statement</summary>
<pre><code class="language-lean">∀ {k : Type u_2} {l : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype k] [inst_1 : DecidableEq k] [inst_2 : Fintype l]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq l] {Ω : Type u_6} [inst_4 : MeasurableSpace Ω] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  [inst_5 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] {Z : Nat → Ω → l → Real} {X : Nat → Ω → k → Real}
  {e Y : Nat → Ω → Real} {β : k → Real}
  [inst_6 : Fact (instLTNat.lt 0 (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card l) (Fintype.card k)))],
  HansenEconometrics.TwoSLSObservedIidFourthMomentPositiveCovarianceConditions μ Z X e Y β →
    ∀ (hZ0 : Measurable (Z 0)) [MeasureTheory.SigmaFinite (μ.trim ⋯)],
      HansenEconometrics.HomoskedasticErrorVariance μ Z e →
        ∀ {crit : Real} {alpha : ENNReal},
          Eq
              (MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe
                (HansenEconometrics.chiSquared (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card l) (Fintype.card k))) (Set.Ioi crit))
              alpha →
            And
              (MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
                (fun m ω =&gt;
                  HansenEconometrics.twoSLSSarganStatOrZero (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors Z m ω)
                    (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors X m ω) (HansenEconometrics.stackOutcomes Y m ω))
                Filter.atTop (fun x =&gt; x) (fun x =&gt; μ)
                (HansenEconometrics.chiSquared (instHSub.hSub (Fintype.card l) (Fintype.card k))))
              (Filter.Tendsto
                (fun m =&gt;
                  MeasureTheory.Measure.instFunLike.coe μ
                    (setOf fun ω =&gt;
                      Real.instLT.lt crit
                        (HansenEconometrics.twoSLSSarganStatOrZero (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors Z m ω)
                          (HansenEconometrics.stackRegressors X m ω) (HansenEconometrics.stackOutcomes Y m ω))))
                Filter.atTop (nhds alpha))</code></pre>
</details>
